title: VTC Events — Access — Show — payload
description: Read where an event happens and how to join it: answered to a registrant who is going, and to the event's hosts, from the event's `revealAt` if it has one. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Events — Access — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/access/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/access/show/0.1#response.

access.description: The access details as they stand. May be empty where the hosts have not stated any yet.

sequence.description: The event's `sequence` now, so the reader knows which version of the access details it holds (VTI-EVT-063).
